conventions.bbox: [x0, y0, x1, y1], fractions of the PDF page (A4, incl. the white frame around the scan)

drawings.description: croquis en marge, à hauteur de la définition de $Z_2$ :
drawings.kind: margin square X x T <- X x T x T', T <- T x T'
drawings.notes: X x T <- X x T x T' above, T <- T x T' below, joined by plain vertical strokes, as in the tikzcd of the transcription.

drawings.kind: margin diagram X - Y, X x T -> Y x T over T
drawings.notes: X - Y (the stroke shows no head), X x T -> Y x T (the arrow has a mark at its tail), a vertical arrow from X x T down and a diagonal arrow from Y x T down to T. Under the vertical arrow an overwritten (struck) letter stands left of T; both arrows are drawn ending as on the page.
